hero.label: Our story
hero.sub: We didn't start a business. We started a mission — to keep a 300-year-old craft alive, fairly and beautifully.

story.title: How The Weaving Co. began
story.paragraph1: It started on a winter trip to Srinagar. Walking through the old city, I stumbled into a workshop where an old craftsman sat at a loom, his fingers moving with the quiet confidence of someone who had done this ten thousand times. He was making a Kani shawl — a process that takes three months. He told me he earned less per shawl than most people spend on a meal.
story.paragraph2: I came home and couldn't stop thinking about it. There had to be a way to connect people who appreciate genuine craft with the people who create it. The Weaving Co. is that bridge — a direct line from the looms of Amritsar to your wardrobe, with nothing in between except honesty.

values.title: What we stand for
values.sub: Four principles that guide every decision we make

items.title: Radical authenticity
items.body: Every claim we make is verifiable. GI tags, Woolmark certification, artisan names on certificates — no vague "handcrafted" without proof.

items.title: Fair trade, always
items.body: Our artisans earn 3× the regional average. We publish our pricing model. We believe transparency is the highest form of respect.

items.title: Craft preservation
items.body: We fund apprenticeships for young Amritsari craftspeople. Dying techniques like Sozni embroidery and fine pashmina weaving deserve a future, not just a history.

items.title: Zero compromise on quality
items.body: If a shawl doesn't meet our standards, it doesn't ship. We'd rather have fewer products than ones we're not proud of.
